text:
emma: FYI customers in EU reporting a spike of 503s and timeouts since ~10:45 UTC. multiple retries, one customer hit duplicate charges. raising P1.

support-ops: creating incident now. can you paste an example req_id + response body? any pattern on model/size?

emma: req_id: rq_8b3c9f2e, response: 503 gateway timeout, client saw Connection reset. model: rwd-infer-v2-8h_q8, long prompt. header x-api-key masked.

govind_oncall: I'm oncall, starting triage. initial kube events show inference-worker pod on node-3 restarted at 10:44:58 with exit code 137 (OOM?). grabbing node dmesg and container logs.

linda_sre: dmesg from node-3 shows GPU errors right before the container kill. snippet:
```
Mar 17 10:44:57 node-3 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
Mar 17 10:44:57 node-3 kernel: oom_kill_process: Killed process 23456 (inference-worker) total-vm:3200000kB, anon-rss:3100000kB
container runtime: container exited with status 137
```

samir_eng: runner logs show a segfault right before restart as well:
```
[2026-03-17T10:44:57Z] runner: fatal signal: SIGSEGV at 0 ip=0x7f8d2b3c0f2a sp=0x7ffc3c1a2e80
... at kvcache.cpp:412 (kvcache::prefetch)
[2026-03-17T10:44:57Z] runner: aborting process
```

kevin_billing: we already have customers pinging billing. duplicates because client retried on 503 then got 2xx later. need list of impacted req_ids/time window to evaluate reversals.

support-ops: billing, flagged window 10:44:30-10:46:00 across eu-hosted pool. I'll export req_ids once we have logs.

govind_oncall: quick repro I ran locally: heavy long-context request (~120k tokens) + batch_size=6 against rwd-infer-v2-8h_q8 led to large contiguous GPU allocations, then a prefetch path triggered OOB and segfault. repro curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-infer-v2-8h_q8","input":"<~120k tokens>","batch_size":6}'
```

linda_sre: mitigation for hosted pool: temporary routing change to clamp max_context=32k and set max_batch_size=1 for the affected node pool; also enable fallback routing to dedicated if account allows. doing the routing change now (will take ~2m).

samir_eng: hypothesis: kv-cache prefetch path + quantized buffer growth can produce an out-of-bounds write when sequence length and batch interactions hit a corner case. that explains segfault+OOM. adding bounds checks locally.

govind_oncall: pushed a hotfix to catch OOB on prefetch and return a 5xx allocation-failure before any segfault. will canary the runtime change.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy triggered: canary/rwd-runtime-prefetch-fix-2026-03-17 -> 2 pods in canary group.

emma: Customer on the call wants ETA for full fix and a rollback/mitigation plan. they mentioned switching to dedicated if hosted remains unstable.

support-ops: ETA: hotfix in canary now; 6h to validate and roll to prod if canary stable. rollback plan: route heavy contexts to dedicated or to a smaller model in ~15m if we see continued 503s.

kevin_billing: I'll start work on an itemized list for refunds/holds; need the req_id export from support-ops.

emma: I'll DM kevin the req_id CSV and share the customer call summary. thanks. keep updates here. :thumbsup:

govind_oncall: adding extra runtime logs for prefetch size, attempted allocs, and kvcache index to help postmortem. will schedule a follow-up retro after stability.

support-ops: incident created INC-2026-0317-1209, priority=P1, owners: @govind_oncall (eng-runtime) and @linda_sre (infra). keeping customer updated.
